subject: Run generic actor line crossing after Execute
description: `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_041/replay-007-session-0001.jsonl.zst` formerly first diverged after frame 823 on PC125's map increment: Original `(-0.70952106,-0.70468414)`, Rust `(-0.957984,-0.2868218)`. PC125's generic dying Execute relocated the actor through `FindPlaceToDie`, but Rust did not run the base Actor line-crossing boundary for that post-Execute segment. Original `RHElementActor::Hourglass` calls the complete virtual `Execute`, applies its wait modifier, then calls `CheckForLineCrossing` before interpreting the returned motion state (`original-code/RHelementactor.cpp:526-690`). `CheckForLineCrossing` collects one active `LINE_CROSS` list, removes only duplicate elevation bonds with identical type and geometry and candidates containing the old position, and, when more than one line remains, runs `UpdateRoll` and `ComputeIncrementAll(mpOrder->bComputeDirection)` even if none is an elevation bond (`original-code/RHelementactor.cpp:6542-6810`). Commit `9f3ccfa9494a10f774303e3d6166a771a0f8b964` restores that boundary for generic/non-movement Execute owners, retains the entry order's compute-direction flag, and preserves the unified candidate count and callback ordering. Focused coverage exercises one versus two non-elevation crossings, cached versus uncached increments, multi-flag uniqueness, elevation duplicate filtering, old-position filtering, and callback-less crossing candidates. The final exact-EOF validation also includes commit `613d3d092d963a98de92726236bc7d3d80bfc9f5`, which independently restores Original's `bComputeDirection=false` on translated damage-reaction orders (`original-code/RHelementactorhuman.cpp:2315-2477`); Task404 consumes that source-correct flag but does not claim the broader damage fix as its own. On the combined current runner the representative matches exact EOF. Savegame_045 replay-014 remains at its independent PC99 ten-field frontier after frame 1298, and same-save replay-003 remains at its independent frame-1191 Projectile121 lifecycle frontier.
